blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A 24-year-old truck helper was killed, while the driver and a second helper were injured on Thursday after their vehicle reportedly suffered brake failure and overturned along the bypass road in Gumaca, Quezon. Quezon police on Friday (October 23) said the truck was carrying 200 plastic crates containing approximately 1,200 live chickens when it negotiated a descending but curved stretch of the road in Barangay Villa Arcaya at 7:10 a.m. READ: Motorcycle back-rider dies, 2 hurt in Quezon road crash The 36-year-old truck driver lost control of his brakes.
